title: Carlos at the Station
text:
Carlos is at the train station. He looks at the map on the wall. The map shows platform one and platform two. His train leaves from platform two.

The timetable says the train leaves at 14:20. It arrives in the city at 15:45. The ticket costs five euros. Carlos is happy because the train is on time.

questions.text: What time does the train leave?
Why does Carlos look at the map?
options: He wants to buy a newspaper.
He wants to take a taxi.
He wants to find the right platform.
He wants to call a friend.

questions.text: Why does the passage say the train is on time?
options: It leaves and arrives at the times in the timetable.

vocabulary.definition: the place at a station where people wait for and get on a train
a list that shows the times when trains or buses leave and arrive
a small paper or card that you need to travel on a train or bus
gets to a place at the end of a journey

paragraph_translations: Carlos está na estação de trem. Ele olha para o mapa na parede. O mapa mostra a plataforma um e a plataforma dois. O trem dele sai da plataforma dois.
O horário diz que o trem sai às 14h20. Ele chega à cidade às 15h45. O bilhete custa cinco euros. Carlos está feliz porque o trem está no horário.
